speaker: Doctor
text: That's an unusual combination of symptoms. Can you tell me if your double vision improves when you close one eye, and do you experience any drooping eyelids or difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; the fluctuation of symptoms and specific triggers strongly suggest a neuromuscular issue. Does your double vision ever disappear temporarily, and have you noticed any facial muscle weakness or slurred speech?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.
